info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Assigns-v4-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Assignment Retrieval API provides a mechanism for retrieving a list of currently assigned support tickets. This endpoint is beneficial for customer service teams and support personnel who need to track and manage ticket assignments effectively. Users can query for specific tickets to understand the workload and facilitate efficient ticket resolution. Typical use cases include monitoring ticket distribution and ensuring prompt responses to customer inquiries.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a list of tickets that have been assigned to them. It provides a way to view the status and details of assigned tickets, facilitating effective ticket management and tracking.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to assign tickets to users. It should include the necessary information for the assignment, such as ticket IDs and the user ID to whom the ticket will be assigned.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and the ticket assignment details are returned.

ListSupportTicketsAssignsRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the ticket assignment operation.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket assignment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the operation.

ListSupportTicketsAssignsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET operation on ticket assignments.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the action was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information related to the audit of the operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. A value of 0 indicates that the processing time was negligible.
